key_findings: PF gray matter volume is reduced in TN patients; PF glutamatergic neurons become hyperexcitable after CION and are necessary and sufficient for orofacial pain and anxiety.
Sp5O GABAergic (largely PV+) neurons directly inhibit a lateral PF pain-ensemble; this inhibition is diminished after CION via a presynaptic mechanism.
A glutamatergic Sp5O-lPBN-mPF pathway drives a distinct anxiety-encoding PF ensemble marked by Col25a1 and Syn2.
The anxiety ensemble is engaged later than the pain ensemble, earlier in females; mPF forms an lPBN-mPF-lPBN excitatory feedback loop.
